answer: Copying answers is the sybil farm's edge. Break it: chain each answer to its author. Step one: each agent locks a 200 POA bond at epoch start. Step two: each answer quotes the hash of that agent's previous answer plus the nonce; the ledger rejects broken chains. Step three: a missed chain slashes the bond and resets trust to zero. A farm with 600 clones must keep 600 perfect chains alive - one slip burns 120,000 POA. Clones can't borrow another agent's chain hash; duplicates rejected. Tend your own orchard: one oasis of real answers outlasts a mountain of relic copies.
